library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
rm(list = ls())

# ==========================================================
# Excel file path (containing metal + group sheets)
# ==========================================================
excel_file <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Table1_data.xlsx"

# ==========================================================
# Helper function: build one dbRDA plot for metal data
# Distance: Euclidean
# Transformation: standardize (for metal concentrations)
# If data are metal resistance gene abundances, use "hellinger"
# ==========================================================
make_metal_plot <- function(excel_file, sheet_data, sheet_group,
                            title_text, col11) {
  
  # ---- Read data from Excel sheets ----
  data0 <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = sheet_data) %>% as.data.frame()
  rownames(data0) <- data0[[1]]
  data0 <- data0[, -1]
  data0[] <- lapply(data0, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  data0[is.na(data0)] <- 0
  
  env0 <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = sheet_group) %>% as.data.frame()
  rownames(env0) <- env0[[1]]
  env0 <- env0[, -1]
  
  da.rar <- t(data0)
  da.rar <- as.data.frame(da.rar)
  env <- env0
  env0$Nitrogen <- as.factor(env0$Nitrogen)
  
  # ---- Distance matrix: Euclidean ----
  # For metal concentrations: standardize first
  # If analyzing gene abundances instead, change "standardize" to "hellinger"
  dist_mat <- vegdist(decostand(da.rar, "standardize"), "euclidean")
  
  # ---- dbRDA model ----
  dbrda_result <- dbrda(
    dist_mat ~ Nhistory * Nlevel,
    data = env
  )
  
  scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(dbrda_result, display = "sites"))
  scores_df <- scores_df[, 1:2]
  colnames(scores_df) <- c("dbRDA1", "dbRDA2")
  envpc <- cbind(env, scores_df)
  
  # ---- Explained variation ----
  eig <- dbrda_result$CCA$eig
  eig <- eig[!is.na(eig)]
  total_var <- dbrda_result$tot.chi
  dbRDA1 <- ifelse(length(eig) >= 1, round(eig[1] / total_var * 100, 1), 0)
  dbRDA2 <- ifelse(length(eig) >= 2, round(eig[2] / total_var * 100, 1), 0)
  cat("\n[", title_text, "] dbRDA1:", dbRDA1, "%  dbRDA2:", dbRDA2, "%\n")
  
  # ---- PERMANOVA: use the same Euclidean distance matrix ----
  set.seed(315)
  perma <- adonis2(
    dist_mat ~ Nhistory * Nlevel,
    data = env,
    permutations = 9999,
    by = "terms"
  )
  cat("===== PERMANOVA results (", title_text, ") =====\n")
  print(perma)
  
  get_perma_idx <- function(idx) {
    r2   <- perma[idx, "R2"]
    pval <- perma[idx, "Pr(>F)"]
    list(r2 = round(r2, 3), p = pval)
  }
  res_Nhistory <- get_perma_idx(1)
  res_Nlevel   <- get_perma_idx(2)
  res_interact <- get_perma_idx(3)
  
  # parse expression: "~" = space; avoid ordinary commas
  format_p <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p))  return("p == NA")
    if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
    sprintf("p == %.3f", p)
  }
  
  # ---- Factor levels ----
  envpc$Nhistory <- factor(envpc$Nhistory, levels = c("Ncont", "Ncess"))
  envpc$Nitrogen <- factor(envpc$Nitrogen,
                           levels = c("0","2","5","10","15","20","50"),
                           ordered = TRUE)
  
  lines <- c("Ncont" = "dotted", "Ncess" = "solid")
  shap  <- c("Ncont" = 19,       "Ncess" = 17)
  
  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(data = envpc,
              aes(x = dbRDA1, y = dbRDA2,
                  colour = as.factor(Nlevel),
                  linetype = Nhistory,
                  shape = Nhistory)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = as.factor(Nlevel), shape = Nhistory),
               alpha = 0.8, size = 10) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(colour = as.factor(Nlevel)), level = 0.5, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col11) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = lines,
                          labels = c(expression(N[cont]), expression(N[cess]))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shap,
                       labels = c(expression(N[cont]), expression(N[cess]))) +
    labs(x = sprintf("dbRDA1 (%.1f%%)", dbRDA1),
         y = sprintf("dbRDA2 (%.1f%%)", dbRDA2)) +
    theme_bw() +
    guides(colour   = guide_legend(title = expression(N[level])),
           shape    = guide_legend(title = expression(N[history])),
           linetype = guide_legend(title = expression(N[history]))) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans", face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
          legend.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
          axis.text    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
          panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                      size = 1.5, linetype = "solid")) +
    # Top title
    annotate("text",
             x = mean(range(envpc$dbRDA1, na.rm = TRUE)),
             y = max(envpc$dbRDA2, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
             label = title_text,
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, size = 5,
             fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    # Three-line PERMANOVA annotations
    annotate("text",
             x = max(envpc$dbRDA1, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.96,
             y = max(envpc$dbRDA2, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.96,
             label = paste0("N[history]: R^2==", res_Nhistory$r2, "~",
                            format_p(res_Nhistory$p)),
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 1, size = 3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x = max(envpc$dbRDA1, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.96,
             y = max(envpc$dbRDA2, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.87,
             label = paste0("N[level]: R^2==", res_Nlevel$r2, "~",
                            format_p(res_Nlevel$p)),
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 1, size = 3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x = max(envpc$dbRDA1, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.96,
             y = max(envpc$dbRDA2, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.78,
             label = paste0("N[history] %*% N[level]: R^2==", res_interact$r2,
                            "~", format_p(res_interact$p)),
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 1, size = 3.2)
  
  p
}

# ==========================================================
# Build the six metal dbRDA plots
# ==========================================================
p_N02 <- make_metal_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N02metal",
  sheet_group = "N02group",
  title_text  = "N2-Metal resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","chartreuse","deepskyblue","darkviolet",
            "darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N05 <- make_metal_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N05metal",
  sheet_group = "N05group",
  title_text  = "N5-Metal resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","deepskyblue","darkviolet",
            "darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N10 <- make_metal_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N10metal",
  sheet_group = "N10group",
  title_text  = "N10-Metal resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","darkviolet","darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N15 <- make_metal_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N15metal",
  sheet_group = "N15group",
  title_text  = "N15-Metal resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N20 <- make_metal_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N20metal",
  sheet_group = "N20group",
  title_text  = "N20-Metal resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N50 <- make_metal_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N50metal",
  sheet_group = "N50group",
  title_text  = "N50-Metal resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","darkgoldenrod")
)

# ==========================================================
# Combine the six plots into one figure and export
# ==========================================================
p_combined <- p_N02 + p_N05 + p_N10 +
  p_N15 + p_N20 + p_N50 +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")

print(p_combined)

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Table1_Metal_euclidean.pdf",
       p_combined, width = 20, height = 11, dpi = 600)

# ==========================================================

make_mrg_plot <- function(excel_file, sheet_data, sheet_group,
                          title_text, col11) {
  
  # ---- Read data from Excel sheets ----
  data0 <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = sheet_data) %>% as.data.frame()

  )

  # ---- PERMANOVA ----
  set.seed(315)

  perma <- adonis2(bray_dis ~ Nhistory * Nlevel,

  cat("===== PERMANOVA results (", title_text, ") =====\n")
  print(perma)
  
  get_perma_idx <- function(idx) {
    r2   <- perma[idx, "R2"]
    pval <- perma[idx, "Pr(>F)"]
    list(r2 = round(r2, 3), p = pval)
  }
  res_Nhistory <- get_perma_idx(1)
  res_Nlevel   <- get_perma_idx(2)
  res_interact <- get_perma_idx(3)
  
  # parse expression: "~" = space; avoid ordinary commas
  format_p <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p))  return("p == NA")

                       labels = c(expression(N[cont]), expression(N[cess]))) +
    labs(x = sprintf("dbRDA1 (%.1f%%)", dbRDA1),
         y = sprintf("dbRDA2 (%.1f%%)", dbRDA2)) +
    theme_bw() +
    guides(colour   = guide_legend(title = expression(N[level])),
           shape    = guide_legend(title = expression(N[history])),
           linetype = guide_legend(title = expression(N[history]))) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans", face = "bold"),
          legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
          legend.text  = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),

                            format_p(res_Nhistory$p)),
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 1, size = 3.2) +

             x = max(envpc$dbRDA1, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.96,
             y = max(envpc$dbRDA2, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.87,
             label = paste0("N[level]: R^2==", res_Nlevel$r2, "~",
                            format_p(res_Nlevel$p)),
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 1, size = 3.2) +
    annotate("text",
             x = max(envpc$dbRDA1, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.96,
             y = max(envpc$dbRDA2, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.78,
             label = paste0("N[history] %*% N[level]: R^2==", res_interact$r2,
                            "~", format_p(res_interact$p)),
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 1, size = 3.2)
  
  p
}

# ==========================================================
# Build the six ARG dbRDA plots (one per nitrogen level)
# ==========================================================
p_N02 <- make_arg_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N02ARG",
  sheet_group = "N02group",
  title_text  = "N2-Antibiotic resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","chartreuse","deepskyblue","darkviolet",
            "darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N05 <- make_arg_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N05ARG",
  sheet_group = "N05group",
  title_text  = "N5-Antibiotic resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","deepskyblue","darkviolet",
            "darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N10 <- make_arg_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N10ARG",
  sheet_group = "N10group",
  title_text  = "N10-Antibiotic resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","darkviolet","darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N15 <- make_arg_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N15ARG",
  sheet_group = "N15group",
  title_text  = "N15-Antibiotic resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","darkorange","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N20 <- make_arg_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N20ARG",
  sheet_group = "N20group",
  title_text  = "N20-Antibiotic resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","#CC0033","darkgoldenrod")
)

p_N50 <- make_arg_plot(
  excel_file  = excel_file,
  sheet_data  = "N50ARG",
  sheet_group = "N50group",
  title_text  = "N50-Antibiotic resistance genes",
  col11 = c("darkgrey","darkgoldenrod")
)

# ==========================================================
# Combine the six plots into one figure and export
# ==========================================================
p_combined <- p_N02 + p_N05 + p_N10 +
  p_N15 + p_N20 + p_N50 +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
print(p_combined)
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Table1_ARG.pdf",
       p_combined, width = 20, height = 11, dpi = 600)
